(Japanese: '''カサドシティ''' ''Kasado City'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive city on [[Silver Rock Isle]], one of the [[Whirl Islands]] in the [[Johto]] [[region]]. 

It first appeared at the end of ''[[EP218|Plant It Now... Diglett Later]]'' as {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} reached Silver Rock Isle. The trio explored Kasado City's sprawling markets and met up with local gift shop owner [[Ariene]] in ''[[EP219|Hi Ho Silver... Away!]]''. She escorted the group to meet her friend [[Jenaro]], a local silver rock craftsman, to learn more about the [[Silver Wing]]. The city's streets are decorated with Silver Wing banners.

Kasado City was also mentioned to be the [[hometown]] of {{OBP|Shinji|The Legend of Thunder!}} in ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]''.
